verdict.rationale: Workable is a SaaS recruiting platform, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair axis. Its own API docs host a dedicated 'Workable MCP server' reference page, and a probe confirmed that page exists. The page claims full programmatic access across the hiring lifecycle, from job management and sourcing through offer approvals. Missing for 10: documented connection and setup details (auth/token scopes, transport, client configuration), and independent or hands-on corroboration that agents connect successfully.
